title: MUUNRiver-Bench: Diagnosing Relation-Dependent Music Retrieval with Multimodal Instructions
abstract: arXiv:2609.16090v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Music retrieval is relation-dependent: given a reference track, a listener may seek its style with a new theme, a cover, or a comparable voice, and these intents demand contradictory rankings. We present MUUNRiver-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark whose reference-audio queries use natural-language instructions to define relevance. A pipeline combining expert genre priors, LLM-generated prompts and lyrics, synthesis, and expert review yields 3,440 tracks spanning 13 genres and 116 sub-genres, and seven tasks: similar-music, style-preserving lyric-rewriting, lyric-preserving style-rewriting, cover, vocal-timbre, isolated-vocal, and segment retrieval. Across six models in eight configurations, task-wise rank reversals reveal complementary biases: acoustic encoders favour local identity, whereas text-aligned encoders favour semantic relations. translated_title: MUUNRiver-Bench：用多模态指令诊断依赖关系的音乐检索
translated_abstract: 音乐检索是依赖于关系的：给定一首参考曲目，听众可能想寻找具有新主题的相同风格音乐、翻唱版本，或音色相近的演唱，而这些意图需要相互矛盾的排序结果。我们提出了 MUUNRiver-Bench，这是一个诊断性基准，其参考音频查询使用自然语言指令来定义相关性。一个结合了专家流派先验知识、LLM 生成的提示词与歌词、合成以及专家评审的流程，生成了 3,440 首曲目，涵盖 13 个流派和 116 个子流派，并设计了七个任务：相似音乐检索、保留风格的歌词改写、保留歌词的风格改写、翻唱、人声音色、分离人声以及片段检索。在八种配置下的六个模型上，任务级别的排序反转揭示了互补的偏差：声学编码器偏向局部一致性，而文本对齐编码器偏向语义关系。冻结编码器用于诊断默认的相似性偏好，而指令感知与音频-文本融合系统则展现了不同的表现。
tldr: 该论文提出 MUUNRiver-Bench 诊断基准，通过多模态自然语言指令和七项任务评估音乐检索模型，揭示了声学编码器偏好局部一致性、文本对齐编码器偏好语义关系的互补性排序偏差。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MUUNRiver-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark using multimodal natural-language instructions and seven tasks to evaluate music retrieval models, revealing complementary ranking biases where acoustic encoders favor local identity while text-aligned encoders favor semantic relations.
